A '''fire orb''' is a glass orb that has been charged at the [[Obelisk of Fire]] by using the [[Charge Fire Orb]] spell, requiring 63 [[Magic]], on the obelisk. The spell requires an [[unpowered orb]], 30 [[fire rune]]s, and 3 [[cosmic rune]]s, yielding 73 Magic [[experience]]. [[Obelisk of Fire|The Fire Obelisk]] is located at the end of [[Taverley Dungeon]], west of the [[black dragon]]s.

A fire orb can be used on a [[battlestaff]], requiring 62 [[Crafting]], yielding a [[fire battlestaff]] and 125 Crafting experience.

They are also obtainable by [[pickpocketing]] [[gnomes]], [[hero]]es, and [[Elf (Thieving)|elves]] or from killing [[Cerberus]], [[killerwatt]]s, [[lava dragon]]s, [[Tormented Demon|tormented demons]] or level 61 [[Zombie (Tarn's Lair)|zombie]]s in [[Tarn's Lair]].
